title.rendered: Sage First BBC and Breeding Session

content.rendered:
I had just gotten back from my monthly trip to Salt Lake City when the message came in from Sage. She wanted to know if I’d be interested in getting together on my next visit. Turns out the beautiful redhead had been curious about having her first experience with a Black man.

We spent the next few weeks messaging, building the anticipation until we locked in a date for my return.

Ciren’s layover in Las Vegas turned into a cancellation, and she told me she’d volunteered to stay overnight so she could catch the first flight out in the morning. It was already late when she called, so I offered to pick her up, heat something up, and let her crash at my place until she needed to head back to the airport.
